title: Derived realization square for the explicit component section map
statement: For Lambda commutative condensed, T affine and the continuous braided finite-exact component inverse image, let alpha identify the pulled-back coefficient with the affine coefficient. The functor Evaluation.F on the profinite slice followed by componentDerived is naturally isomorphic to derived extension along the constructed componentSectionMap followed by affine Evaluation.F. The section map is fixed rather than existential; it need not be bijective. No point factorization, scalar condition or weak contractibility is assumed. The underlying definitions are those of [def-zl-condensed-lisse-evaluation-model].

proof.text: Choose functorial flat-term K-flat resolutions over the source section ring. Constant sheafification and inverse image preserve the relevant colimits and tensor comparisons. The unit/global-section construction identifies the coefficient map in this comparison exactly with componentSectionMap.

On these representatives construct the balanced tensor maps b⊗(a⊗p)↦ba⊗p and b⊗p↦b⊗(1⊗p). Balancing proves they are mutual inverses, and checking on pure tensors gives linearity, differential compatibility and naturality. Pullback preserves the flat-term K-flat models.

Tensor descent localizes the natural chain isomorphism on unbounded K-flat resolutions. Use the universal K-flat comparisons of the fixed extension models and exact sectionwise/internal module equivalences to obtain the displayed functor isomorphism. Zero rings give zero tensor modules with the same maps.
